what_slowed_me_down: Several pricing pages are heavily JavaScript-driven and did not render their pricing content on the first pass with Apify's adaptive crawler, returning only navigation chrome or error pages (Asana, Clockify, Framer, Semrush, Canva, Fireflies, Notion, GitLab). This required re-running those URLs with the Firefox headless browser, residential US proxies, longer dynamic-content waits, and htmlTransformer set to 'none' to capture the raw rendered DOM. Canva additionally localized prices to Moroccan Dirham on the first run because the proxy egress was not in the US, so it had to be re-scraped with a US residential proxy to get USD. A second slowdown was that many pages render prices behind a monthly/annual billing toggle, so the markdown often contained only one of the two price sets (usually the annual per-month rate), and some pages (Notion, GitLab) loaded prices so late that they were missing entirely until re-scraped with longer waits. Finally, extracting clean plan/price pairs from 40 differently-structured markdown documents required careful manual review of each page rather than a single automated parser.
